description_en: Deletes a short URL. After deletion, the short URL becomes unusable and cannot be restored to the original URL
description_zh: 删除短链，删除后短链将无法使用，无法还原为原链
name: DeleteShortUrl

parameters.help_en:
The original URL. The URL can be up to 1,000 characters in length.
<notice>Short Message Service (SMS) does not currently support this operation.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
原始链接地址。不超过1000个字符。
<notice>短信服务暂时不支持使用此接口。></notice>
parameters.name: source_url
